The '''Moloskia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mbandamonte sector/Legends|Mbandamonte sector]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Moloskian]]s.<ref name="Hutt Gambit" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Moloskia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square N-15.<ref name="TEA" />
